note: Hot lead by email: urgent redesign, $15-25k. Expect HubSpot contact + deal + note, Gmail draft in the thread, Slack alert.
subject: Website redesign before storm season ends
body:
Hi there,

I own Whitfield Roofing in Aurora. 22 employees, in business since 2009. Our website is from 2016, looks terrible on phones, and we're losing jobs to competitors with better sites. We'd like a full redesign with online quote requests and before/after photo galleries.

Budget is $15,000-$25,000. We want to start right away so the new site is live before the end of October. Can we talk this week?

Dana Whitfield
Owner, Whitfield Roofing
(303) 555-0147
